cards.title: Loss of Human Connection Biggest Threat to Kids, Not AI
cards.body: A pediatrician argues that human connection matters more than screen time fears. The solution to tech concerns is spending more time talking openly with children.

cards.title: Making Halloween Magic for Your Kids
cards.body: A parent ditches cynicism to embrace Halloween traditions with children. Celebrating autumn creates moments of magic and connection for families.

cards.title: Why Kids Say 'Na-na, na-na-na!' and Why It Annoys
cards.body: Readers explore why this universal childhood taunt is so irritating to parents. Understanding juvenile put-downs helps families navigate annoying behaviors.

cards.title: Yearly Tradition Brings Family Together After Child Moves Out
cards.body: A parent finds connection through making jam with their child each citrus season. Annual traditions bridge the gap when adult children move away.

cards.title: 10 Truths Teens Want Parents to Know
cards.body: A psychotherapist shares insights from working with teenagers about their developmental needs. Understanding what teens want helps parents and carers support them better.

cards.title: How Parents Can Help College Students With Mid-Semester Meltdowns
cards.body: Five evidence-based strategies help college students regain control when grades slip. Parents can use these techniques instead of rushing in to fix problems.

cards.title: Managing Misophonia at the Holiday Dinner Table
cards.body: Misophonia can make holiday meals with family challenging for those affected. Thoughtful accommodations help families enjoy meaningful memories together.

cards.title: How Estrangement From Adult Children Can Be Healed
cards.body: Parents who recognize their own behavior can create opportunities for reconciliation with estranged adult children. Understanding and acceptance are key to rebuilding relationships.
